name: 弗朗西斯·培根

identity.findings: 弗朗西斯·培根（Francis Bacon，1561-01-22 伦敦约克府生—1626-04-09 Highgate 卒），伊丽莎白一世与詹姆斯一世朝英格兰政治家、法学家、自然哲学家：父尼古拉斯·培根（Sir Nicholas Bacon）为伊丽莎白掌玺大臣（lord keeper），母安妮（Anne Cooke）为其第二任妻子（均 SEP）。站内 canonical 键「弗朗西斯·培根」与本人一致；站内另有「罗吉尔·培根」（Roger Bacon，约1214-1292?），为不同人物，无重复问题。生卒、仕历（副检察长 1607、检察总长 1613、御前大臣 1617、大法官 1618、维鲁拉姆男爵 1618、圣奥尔本斯子爵 1621）以 SEP 为准；1621 年受贿弹劾与判决以 Spedding《书信与生平》卷七（1874）为第一手文本核对。人物提示的「1584 进入下议院」与 SEP 记载（1581 年 1 月首次当选，此后每届议会均有席位）不符，按 SEP 修正并保留单源注记。
legacyIssues: 旧 bio/overview 为未核实通稿（来源栏全空）：多数通行事实（生卒、官职、三部代表作、《新大西岛》1627 出版）与本轮来源一致，但多条引语与评价无出处，已逐项重写。
旧 bio 引「马克思称他为『英国唯物主义和整个现代实验科学的真正始祖』」——本轮来源均未核得此语，删除。
旧 bio 称培根方法「为后来的科学家如牛顿提供了理论框架」——过度引申：SEP 记 20 世纪评价恰相反（「a champion of what science has never been」，Rossi 语），哈维更有「像大法官一样写自然哲学」之讥（IEP），改为分层表述。
旧 bio「直接启发了霍布斯、洛克等英国经验论者。霍布斯继承了他的唯物主义倾向」——霍布斯与培根的直接接触本轮核实为「约 1620 年曾任其秘书一段时期」（SEP 霍布斯条目），「继承唯物主义倾向」属流派摘抄式概括，删除；洛克与培根的关系本轮未核，不作断言。

旧 bio「三表法——本质表、差异表与程度表」：Spedding 系术语为 Table of Essence and Presence / Table of Deviation (Absence in Proximity) / Table of Degrees (Comparative)；本轮以《新工具》第二卷箴言 11–13 的结构（肯定实例/否定实例/程度比较）为准表述，不再用来源未核的「差异表」定名。
旧 profile.life/concepts/people/relations/bibliography/sources 全空，本轮全部重建。
旧数据将《新大西岛》出版作 1627 年——与 Gutenberg 版导言一致；SEP 网页作 1626，两存（见 uncertainties）。
wiki_url 指向中文维基（线索层，不作为来源）。

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Francis Bacon
sources.readScope: 两次定向抓取全条目：第一次读「Life in Philosophy, Politics and Law」节（生卒 1561-01-22/1626-04-09、约克府、父母、三一学院 1573-04-05 入学至 1575-12、格雷律师学院 1576、随 Sir Amias Paulet 驻法约两年半、1579 春父丧归、1581 年 1 月首次当选下议员并『sat in every parliament until 1621』、Essex 雇佣与提携、1593 补助金演说、1594 learned counsel、Essex 叛乱后任检控者并奉命写官方说明、1603 爵士、1606 婚、1607 副检察长、1613 检察总长、1616 枢密院、1617 御前大臣、1618-01 大法官、1618-07 维鲁拉姆男爵、1621-01 圣奥尔本斯子爵、1621 春弹劾受贿『he confessed』『a victim of a political campaign』against Buckingham、Tower 短囚；死亡节未提雪鸡故事）。第二次读哲学各节（四假象 NO I:41-44/59-67 及『enchanted glass』；三段论批判 NO I:19、简单枚举『a childish thing』与排除式归纳 OFB XI:31/33；蚂蚁蜘蛛蜜蜂 NO I:95；三表 NO II:11-13 与热的形式例证、『the form of a thing is the very thing itself』、排除程序 NO II:16；知识—power：1590s『the worthiest power』OFB I:247/262/265、NO I:3『human knowledge and human power come to the same thing』；Instauratio 六部分规划及各部分完成情况；Advancement 1605 两卷结构与 De Augmentis 1623 九卷；Essayes 1597-02 初版含 Religious Meditations 与 Places of Perswasion、1612 年末扩版、1625-04 第三版、17 世纪印行 20 余次（未给各版篇数）；New Atlantis『posthumously published in 1626』与所罗门之宫『dedicated to the study of the Works and Creatures of God』、36 名成员、光之商旅等；接受史：Huygens/Beeckman/Gassendi/Mersenne/Descartes 采纳部分观念而『preferred a more rationalist approach』、Mylius 最早详细批评、Hartlib/Comenius/Dury、启蒙与 19 世纪声誉回落、20 世纪 Rossi『a champion of what science has never been』与法兰克福学派批评、Pérez-Ramos 论 1660 皇家学会为『victory of the Baconian project of collaboration, utility, and progress』；物质论：tangible/pneumatic、硫—汞两组 quaternion、spirits、反对天地区分）。条目未覆盖：弹劾条款数、罚金数额、雪鸡故事、各版随笔篇数。

sources.title: Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Francis Bacon (1561-1626)
sources.readScope: 通读主要各节：1 节生平（1561 生、父 Sir Nicholas Bacon 母 Lady Anne Cooke、1573 十二岁入三一学院并称经院课程触发其终身反亚里士多德立场、1576 起读法律、1588 格雷律师学院讲师、1576-79 驻法、父死『virtually without support』、Essex 案『in his capacity as Queen's Counsel, playing a vital role in the prosecution』（未给 1601 年份）、1604 King's Counsel、1607 Solicitor General、1613 Attorney General、1618 Lord Chancellor、Verulam 与 St Albans 头衔未给年份、1621『arrested and charged with bribery』认罪后重罚并判 Tower——『the fine was waived』『spent only four days in the Tower』、禁任官与议会；死于 1626-04-09『supposedly of a cold or pneumonia contracted while testing his theory of the preservative and insulating properties of snow』（未注来源）。b 节 New Atlantis：身后一年刊行（即 1627）『in unfinished form』，Salomon's House（College of the Six Days Works）为皇家学会『effective inspiration and model』与现代研究中心的『early blueprint and prophecy』。j 节四假象（Book I aph 39-68，theatre 假象三分类 sophistical/empirical/superstitious）。k 节归纳（渐进上升）。3 节声誉：哈维『like a Lord Chancellor』之讥、『shrewd hints and guesses…by hypotheses』的批评、Eiseley 与 Adorno/Horkheimer/Mumford/Merchant 两极、结语『a Colossus with feet of clay』。未覆盖：随笔各版篇数、弹劾条款数、ipsa scientia potestas est。

sources.title: Novum Organum（Project Gutenberg eBook #45988，Joseph Devey 编英译本，1902 Collier 版）
sources.readScope: 下载全文（568KB）本地核读：书名页（Novum Organum / or True Suggestions for the Interpretation of Nature / ed. Joseph Devey, P.F. Collier 1902——注意：Gutenberg 此本非 Spedding 译，人物提示所称『古腾堡 Spedding 英译』经核不存在，Gutenberg 收的是 Devey 编译本，已在记录中如实更正）；第一卷：箴言 III『Knowledge and human power are synonymous, since the ignorance of the cause frustrates the effect』（后接『Nature is only subdued by submission』意涵句）；XI（现有逻辑对发现无用）、XII、XIV（『Our only hope, then, is in genuine Induction』）、XIX（两条道路：一条从感官骤升到最普遍公理，一条逐步上升）；XXXIX- XLIV 四假象定义各句（Tribe『uneven mirrors』、Den『his own individual den or cavern』、Market『reciprocal intercourse and society of man with man』、Theatre『various dogmas of peculiar systems of philosophy』）；剧场假象节内柏拉图两处（『more dangerous and refined in Plato and his school』、『The school of Plato introduced scepticism, first, as it were in joke』）；目的因句（『falls back to what is actually less advanced, namely, final causes』）；蚂蚁/蜘蛛/蜜蜂（行 1836 附近，经验派如蚂蚁、教条派如蜘蛛、真正的自然哲学家如蜜蜂）；第二卷：XI 起调查形式的程序（『a nature being given, we must first present to the understanding all the known instances which agree in the same nature』+热的肯定实例清单 1-14）、『our Table of Degrees, or Comparative』（行 4082）、冷的相应表（行 4102）、排除程序（『in our investigation of the form of heat, Reject rarity…』）、『The First Vintage of the Form of Heat』（『the nature whose limit is heat appears to be motion』；『the very essence of heat, or the substantial self of heat, is motion and nothing else, limited, however, by certain differences』）。未核到本版中 Spedding 系『Table of Essence and Presence』『Table of Deviation』标题措辞（系译本差异）；未核卷首题献页与『Multi pertransibunt』格言（本轮不作断言）。

sources.title: Novum Organum 拉丁原文（The Latin Library，1620 年本 Liber Primus 页）
sources.readScope: 抓取 Liber Primus 页全文：箴言 III『Scientia et potentia humana in idem coincidunt, quia ignoratio causae destituit effectum. Natura enim non nisi parendo vincitur: et quod in contemplatione instar causae est, id in operatione instar regulae est』；箴言 XXXIX『Quatuor sunt genera idolorum, quae mentes humanas obsident…ut primum genus, idola tribus; secundum, idola specus; tertium, idola fori; quartum, idola theatri, vocentur』（2026-10-04 复核订正：原记「箴言 X」系定位笔误，四假象命名句在第一卷箴言 XXXIX）；XLII『Idola specus sunt idola hominis individui』；XLIII『…quae idola fori, propter hominum commercium et consortium, appellamus. Homines enim per sermones sociantur; at verba ex captu vulgi imponuntur』；LIX『At idola fori omnium molestissima sunt; quae ex foedere verborum et nominum se insinuarunt in intellectum. Credunt enim homines, rationem suam verbis imperare. Sed fit etiam ut verba vim suam super intellectum retorqueant』；LXI 剧场假象（『ex fabulis theoriarum, et perversis legibus demonstrationum…tot fabulas productas et actas censemus, quae mundos effecerunt fictitios et scenicos』）；XXIII『Non leve quiddam interest inter humanae mentis idola, et divinae mentis ideas』。另抓取 Distributio/题名页（bacon.titlepage.shtml）：『SEQVITVR SECVNDA PARS INSTAURATIONIS, QVAE ARTEM IPSAM Interpretandi Naturam…digestam per summas in Aphorismos』（证 1620 年卷的结构：新工具为《大复兴》第二部分）。

sources.title: James Spedding 编 The Letters and the Life of Francis Bacon 卷七（1874，archive.org 影印 lettersandlifef00bacogoog，1622-1626 年）
sources.readScope: 下载 djvu.txt（2MB）本地核读：1621 年弹劾——『The charges were set out in twenty-eight articles. To each article was appended Bacon's confession and declaration』（二十六卷本卷 265-266 页）；培根逐条自认（第 21、22、23、24-26 款：Smithwick 案 200 镑由仆人经手已令偿还、Buswell 案『three or four hundred pounds…about some months after the cause was decreed』、Barker 案 700 镑、杂货商-药剂师案三笔），并反复申明『he denied that he had ever received such present upon any bargain or contract, or had ever had any bribe or reward in his eye or thought when he pronounced any sentence or order』；判决（卷 269-270 页）：『1. The fine and ransom, 40,000l. 2. Imprisonment during the King's pleasure in the Tower. 3. Uncapable of any office, place, or employment in the State or Commonwealth. 4. Never to sit in Parliament, nor to come within the verge of the Court』；致白金汉信（1621-05-31，自塔中）：『howsoever I acknowledge the sentence just, and for reformation's sake fit, the justest Chancellor that hath been in the five changes since Sir Nicolas Bacon's times』；罗利密写密码记事本句（斯佩丁自其 1874 年卷刊布）：『I was the justest judge that was in England these fifty years. But it was the justest censure in parliament that was these two hundred years』（斯佩丁注明此系 Rawley 私录、未刊之言）；1626 年死事叙述（卷 549-551 页）：『he took advantage of an unseasonable fall of snow to try whether it would preserve flesh from putrefaction, as salt does; and so caught the chill of which he died. The story is, that…the idea suddenly occurring to him, he stopped the coach, alighted at a cottage, obtained a hen, helped to stuff it with snow with his own hands』——斯佩丁明言此层为『the story』；本人最后信件（致 Arundel and Surrey，自 Matthew 集录）：『I was likely to have had the fortune of Caius Plinius the elder…For I was also desirous to try an experiment or two, touching the conservation and induration of bodies. As for the experiment itself, it succeeded excellently well; but in the journey (between London and Highgate) I was taken with such a fit of casting, as I knew not whether it were the stone, or some surfeit, or cold, or indeed a touch of them all three』及湿床致『what would now be called bronchitis…ended in sudden suffocation』的叙事。

sources.title: James Spedding 编 The Letters and the Life of Francis Bacon 卷六（archive.org 影印 lettersandlifef07spedgoog，1601-1613 年）
sources.readScope: 下载 djvu.txt（1.1MB）本地抽查：卷首序言明示本卷（此标识为 f07 者实为丛书第六卷）承接 1601 年 4 月以后至 1613 年底；Essex 案相关——『In drawing up the Declaration of Treasons, Bacon had mentioned his name (Southampton) as slightly as it was possible…』（卷 74-75 页），培根与 Southampton 关系、Essex House 时期安东尼·培根居所（1505-1600? OCR 有误，仅作线索不作断言）；1613 年『made Attorney General. Promotion of Poderidge to the office』及培根 1601 年『Sir Francis Bacon his Apologie』标题页（行 8702）。本卷为第二手证据（斯佩丁考订），用于 Essex 案与 1613 年升迁的辅助印证，主证仍为 SEP。

sources.title: Essayes. Religious meditations. 1597（1597 年初版影印，archive.org BIM Early English Books）
sources.readScope: 下载 djvu.txt（85KB，OCR 粗糙）本地核读：致安东尼·培根题献信（『These fragments of my conceites were going to print…Therefore I helde it best discretion to publish them my selfe…From my Chamber at Graies Inne, this 30. of Ianuarie. 1597』）；随笔目录恰好 10 篇（Of Studies、Of Discourse、Of Ceremonies and Respects、Of Followers and Friends、Of Suitors、Of Expense、Of Regiment of Health、Of Honour and Reputation、Of Faction、第十篇 Negotiating——OCR 中第 9/10 项行列残损，篇数以目录行序核为 10）；拉丁文 MEDITATIONES SACRAE 部分卷内标题与诸则标题（De operibus Dei et hominis、De miraculis Servatoris、De Columbina innocentia、De mensura curarum、De spe terrestri 等六则），其中无「De haeresibus」；第三部分 Places of perswasion（题名页行 9）与内页 The Colours of Good and Evil 标题（行 2607）及 Table of the Colours（行 2773 起）。OCR 长体 s 常误作 f，未对文本逐句引证，仅用于题名、目录与结构判断。

sources.title: The Essayes or Counsels, Civill and Morall, 1625 年定本文本（Project Gutenberg eBook #575）
sources.readScope: 下载全文（324KB）本地核读：目录 59 项 = 58 篇正文（Of Truth 起至 Of Vicissitude of Things）+ 附录残篇 Of Fame；致白金汉公爵献辞（『I have enlarged them, both in Number, and Weight; So that they are indeed a New Worke』署 FR. ST. ALBAN）；Of Truth 开篇『WHAT is truth? said jesting Pilate』；Of Studies 开篇『STUDIES serve for delight, for ornament, and for ability. Their chief use for delight, is in privateness and retiring; for ornament, is in discourse; and for ability, is in the judgment, and disposition of business』。

sources.title: Essayes. Religious meditations. 1612（1612 年扩充版影印，archive.org BIM）
sources.readScope: 下载 djvu.txt（79KB）抽查：正文以 Of Studies 起（『Studies serue for pastimes, for ornament, and for abilities…』）。OCR 混乱，未能清点篇目总数；通行说 38 篇本轮未直接核数，记 uncertain。

sources.title: The Advancement of Learning（Project Gutenberg eBook #5500，Henry Morley 编）
sources.readScope: 下载并核书名页转录：『THE TVVOO Bookes of Francis Bacon. Of the proficience and aduancement of Learning, divine and humane. To the King. At London. Printed for…』（1605 年原题）；Morley 导言称其为詹姆斯初年 Bacon 的重要著作。正文未逐页读。

sources.title: New Atlantis（Project Gutenberg eBook #2434）
sources.readScope: 下载并核：导言行 58『1627, the year after the author's death. It seems to have been written…』；正文中 Salomon's House（『an Order or Society, which we call Salomon's House; the noblest foundation (as we think) that ever was upon the earth…and sometimes the College of the Six Days Works』）。正文未通读。

sources.title: Thomas Sprat, The History of the Royal-Society of London（1667 年初版影印，archive.org）
sources.readScope: 下载 djvu.txt（758KB）本地核读培根相关段落（行 2071 起）：『of these, I shall onely mention one great Man, who had the true Imagination of the whole extent of this Enterprize, as it is now set on foot; and that is, the Lord Bacon. In whose Books there are every where scattered the best arguments, that can be produc'd for the defence of Experimental Philosophy; and the best directions, that are needful to promote it』及随后对培根法律生涯与文风的赞语、『a single and busie hand can never grasp all this whole Design』；行 7061/19152/19678 另三处 Lord Bacon 提及。长体 s OCR 噪声大，引文以可辨读处为准。

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Thomas Hobbes
sources.readScope: 定向抓取传记节：『around 1620, Hobbes worked for some time as a secretary to Francis Bacon』；霍布斯 1588-04-05 生、1679-12-04 卒、1608 年起服务卡文迪什家族约七十年。该条目对轶事（如与 Galileo 友谊）另引 Aubrey；对培根秘书一事未注史源层级，细节（起止年限、工作内容）本轮未再核。

uncertainties: 「知识就是力量」通俗格言的拉丁出处（Meditationes Sacrae「De haeresibus」：ipsa scientia potestas est）未直接核到原刊/Spedding 校本文本；已核到 1597 年刊本仅含拉丁六则且无「De haeresibus」。草稿以《新工具》I.3 为该观念的确定出处，通俗格言按限证表述。
1612 年《随笔集》扩充版的篇数（通行作 38 篇）未能从影印 OCR 直接清点；草稿仅述「扩充」，不写篇数。
《新大西岛》刊年：Gutenberg 版导言作 1627（作者死后一年），SEP 网页作 1626；两存，草稿年份字段并注。
首次进入下议院的年份：SEP 作 1581 年 1 月（人物提示作 1584）；单源，草稿按 SEP 并注明。
雪中填鸡故事的「亲手填雪」「湿床/支气管炎」细节属轶事层（Spedding 明言 The story is…；IEP 用 supposedly）；本人书信只证实实验与急病。人物提示建议查培根《论生与死》——本轮确认该记载不属该书（书信为源），Aubrey 原文未直接读。
1621 年弹劾条款数：Spedding 记大贵族院二十八款；人物提示「23 项」未获来源支持。平民院弹劾与贵族院条款的程序关系未再核。
霍布斯任培根秘书的起止年限与工作内容仅达 SEP 概述层（around 1620, some time）；其 Aubrey 传统的细节未核。
「Multi pertransibunt et augebitur scientia」题铭、《论生与死》（Historia vitae et mortis, 1623）书目条目本轮未核，草稿均不收录。
人物提示中的「Inauguration? Advancement of Learning」「艾ubury? Aubrey」「worms《论事物的本原》」等存疑拼写，按可证来源处理：书名作 The Advancement of Learning；死因轶事按 Spedding 转述层记；《论事物的本原》本轮未核得，不列。
